source_evidence: Exact player 'Your lady claims rights from records older then the crown. I claim rights from records older then the convergence.' V asserts older documentary basis for rival hereditary claim. Aldren Voss, established antiquarian administrator, takes the statement seriously but notes difficulty of substantiating twelve-century-old claim and observes V speaks as though he remembers the earlier world (an impression, not actual recognition or established memory). Cirren independently and truthfully corroborates that party examined surviving original inscriptions from that historical period, without revealing Silverward location, document custody, particular contents, heart, private lineage or artifacts. Voss asks where originals are; he now knows asserted pre-Convergence evidence and Cirren's corroboration, not its location or documentary details. No confirmation of present title, personal ancestry, charter validity or authenticity of any offered tower record. No inspection, concession, summons, report, attack, movement, resource use or roll. Day333~15:46, V chooses how to answer and what evidence to share.
